display_long_description:
# 🦈🤚HAND TRACKING UPDATE! 🤚🦈

Dive into SHARKS, the multiplayer VR game where you and your friends become sharks exploring a living, physics-driven ocean together. Swim, hunt, and team up - with controls so easy anyone can start chomping. You don't even need a controller - just use your hands!

# 🌊 A Living, Reactive Ocean
It's a full-on physics sandbox where everything reacts to everything else. Bite and throw an explosive near a mine, cannonball or other shark and watch the chaos unfold.
[media]
# 👥 Multiplayer with Voice Chat 
Join public rooms to meet new players, or create private ones for friends. Team up to take down challenges - like popping the piñata or battling the Skull Rock skeleton boss - for huge rewards for the whole crew.
[media]
#  🤚Comfort-First Controls
No flapping arms, no complicated setup. Just look where you want to go, left pinch to swim, right pinch to bite. Smooth camera, responsive head-tracking, zero setup - perfect whether you're a VR first-timer or seasoned pro.
[media]
# 🏴‍☠️ Season 1: Pirates — Live Now
Complete quests together, earn XP, and level up through the tiers for exclusive season only rewards.
[media]
# 💰 Collect, Salvage, Customize
Carry loot in your mouth to the salvage cage, hoist it up for Goldfish, then trick out your shark to reflect your personality.
[media]
# 🚗 Play Anywhere
Comfy, low-motion controls make SHARKS a great pick for VR on the go — play as a passenger in a car, boat, or plane.
[media]
# Ready to explore the ocean's depths with friends? Grab your headset and dive in!
